en: A vintage postal card with printed and handwritten text in Russian and Estonian. The top features the Russian word "Печатное". There are address lines printed in Estonian, with handwritten recipient information including the name "Peeter Sünd" and an address. A green 2‑kopeck Imperial Russian postage stamp is affixed in the upper right corner and is cancelled with circular date stamps marked 24 9 17. At the bottom left is the printed sender information "Tallinna Eesti Laenu- ja Hoiu-Ühisus." The card is otherwise plain, with no photograph or illustration.
